info.title: YanMata foundation API
info.description: Implemented endpoints only. Seeded identities; no public registration. Cookie requests require CSRF. Journal data and receipts are encrypted at rest. Cursors are opaque. All dates are ISO 8601; journal date is user-local calendar date.
